planning_notes: No additional serial I/O requirements were provided; therefore no serial_channels are configured.
Button wiring polarity (active-high vs active-low) and pullup usage were not specified. Catalog default pullup/active polarity will be used for digital_input.
The 1-second stop delay after button release is business logic to be implemented in SysML using elapsed_ms.

Buzzer tone frequency/amplitude and whether D6 is driven as a constant tone or intermittent pattern were not specified; model will choose frequency and will set tone_output initial to 0 (silence) until the SysML logic commands it.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Button press state (hold to sound, release to stop after 1s delay)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Buzzer drive frequency; model controls start while pressed and stop 1s after release
